Can you explain the main options in simple terms?
A
Message from Alen Customer Experience Team:
Here are the main setup options in simple terms: 
Forever Guarantee: You’ll activate it by registering your Alen.
Register your purifier: You’ll enter your Serial number, choose Your Alen model, select Where did you purchase your Alen?, and add your Purchase date.
Set up your filter subscription: You’ll choose What kind of filter do you want? and How often do you want us to send you a replacement? (this includes Subscribe & Save).
Set up payment: You’ll use Set up payment to add your preferred payment method to finalize your subscription.
Alen Air app: You can connect to WiFi using the Alen Air app to control your unit remotely, monitor your air quality, and track particulate types.
You can go through these options here: set up your Alen.
